scientific_question: Which specific source records support or fail to support the target-LUAD association?
potential_data_source_class: record-level disease-association database evidence and source literature
dependency_control: Deduplicate publications and upstream records already represented in Open Targets.
adequacy_criterion: At least one traceable LUAD-specific source record or an explicit source-specific NOT_FOUND result.
interpretation_boundary: Association evidence does not by itself identify a causal mechanism.

scientific_question: Do tumour-acquired or inherited genetic observations support a causal role in LUAD biology?
potential_data_source_class: somatic mutation/copy-number and germline association datasets
evidence_quality_checks: LUAD cohort specificity|alteration definition|sample overlap|statistical provenance
dependency_control: Determine whether genetic and expression evidence share TCGA cases or Open Targets source records.
adequacy_criterion: Traceable LUAD-relevant alteration evidence or an explicit queried NOT_FOUND state with coverage recorded.
interpretation_boundary: Genetic association or alteration does not automatically predict pharmacological modulation.

scientific_question: Does target perturbation affect LUAD-relevant cancer-cell fitness?
potential_data_source_class: CRISPR dependency and cancer-cell fitness datasets
evidence_quality_checks: LUAD model annotation|guide quality|screen QC|replicate support|context specificity
dependency_control: Track cell-line lineage, assay version, guide quality, and overlap with external aggregators.
adequacy_criterion: Model-level dependency values with screen provenance and explicit LUAD model coverage.
interpretation_boundary: Cell-line dependency does not establish patient benefit or safe therapeutic direction.

scientific_question: Does controlled modulation change a LUAD-relevant phenotype in the expected direction?
dependency_control: Separate independent experiments from reused cell lines, compounds, and publications.
adequacy_criterion: Controlled, traceable perturbation observations or an explicit assessment that qualifying records were not found.
interpretation_boundary: Model-specific perturbation results require replication and direction-of-action review.

scientific_question: Are there selective compounds with interpretable potency and mechanism against the target?
potential_data_source_class: compound-target activity databases and primary assay records
evidence_quality_checks: target confidence|assay type|potency units|selectivity|mechanism consistency|duplicate detection
dependency_control: Deduplicate assays, compounds, mechanisms, and ChEMBL/Open Targets overlap.
adequacy_criterion: Record-level activity/mechanism evidence with target confidence and assay provenance, or explicit NOT_FOUND.
interpretation_boundary: Activity records do not prove efficacy, selectivity in vivo, or LUAD relevance.

scientific_question: Which therapeutic modalities have direct feasibility evidence for the target?
potential_data_source_class: structural, ligandability, antibody-accessibility, and degrader evidence
dependency_control: Identify ChEMBL and clinical-precedence records reused by tractability frameworks.
adequacy_criterion: At least one traceable modality assessment or an explicit NOT_FOUND result for every assessed modality.
interpretation_boundary: Tractability does not establish biological appropriateness or clinical success.

scientific_question: Has target modulation reached human investigation, for which intervention and disease context?
potential_data_source_class: clinical trial registries and curated development records
evidence_quality_checks: target-linkage basis|disease relevance|intervention identity|trial deduplication|status currency
dependency_control: Deduplicate trials, interventions, sponsors, and Open Targets clinical-precedence records.
adequacy_criterion: Traceable trial-level target linkage or a dated registry search with explicit NOT_FOUND semantics.
interpretation_boundary: Clinical investigation is development precedent, not proof of target validity or efficacy.

scientific_question: Where is the target normally expressed and what physiological exposure context exists?
potential_data_source_class: normal tissue expression and protein-localization datasets
dependency_control: Track tissue, cell-type, assay, donor, and protein-versus-RNA measurement lineage.
adequacy_criterion: Traceable normal-tissue or cell-type measurements with coverage and missingness documented.
interpretation_boundary: Normal expression suggests context for investigation but does not prove toxicity.

scientific_question: Is target loss tolerated, and is essentiality context-specific?
potential_data_source_class: human genetic constraint and normal/cancer essentiality datasets
evidence_quality_checks: metric definition|population/model coverage|normal/cancer context separation|version traceability
dependency_control: Separate germline constraint, normal-cell essentiality, and cancer dependency lineages.
adequacy_criterion: Context-specific essentiality/constraint measurements or explicit coverage-aware NOT_FOUND states.
interpretation_boundary: Genetic intolerance does not directly quantify pharmacological safety or dose tolerance.

scientific_question: What on-target or compound-related toxicity observations exist and in what exposure context?
potential_data_source_class: curated safety databases, toxicology assays, adverse-event data, and literature
evidence_quality_checks: on-target attribution|human relevance|evidence type|record deduplication|causality boundary
dependency_control: Separate on-target from off-target effects and deduplicate reports, studies, compounds, and publications.
adequacy_criterion: Traceable target-liability records or a dated, source-bounded NOT_FOUND result.
interpretation_boundary: Adverse-event associations and report counts do not automatically establish causality.

scientific_question: What on-target or compound-related toxicity observations exist and in what exposure context?
potential_data_source_class: curated safety databases, toxicology assays, adverse-event data, and literature
dependency_control: Separate on-target from off-target effects and deduplicate reports, studies, compounds, and publications.
adequacy_criterion: Exposure-contextualized toxicology observations or an explicit bounded NOT_FOUND result.
interpretation_boundary: Adverse-event associations and report counts do not automatically establish causality.

scientific_question: Is the direction and magnitude of dysregulation reproducible outside the TCGA-LUAD cohort?
evidence_quality_checks: TCGA independence|cohort comparability|direction concordance|effect uncertainty|analysis reproducibility
dependency_control: Confirm that samples and processing lineage are independent of TCGA/recount3.
adequacy_criterion: A reproducible effect estimate from a cohort independent of TCGA/recount3, with comparable phenotype definitions.
interpretation_boundary: Replication strengthens an expression association but does not establish causality.

scientific_question: Which evidence records are independent, derived, duplicated, or of unresolved lineage?
potential_data_source_class: source lineage metadata, record cross-references, and publication identifiers
dependency_control: Treat unresolved lineage as dependent/uncertain; never count records as independent by default.
adequacy_criterion: Every evidence source has an auditable upstream lineage and explicit dependency classification.
interpretation_boundary: A lineage audit changes confidence in independence, not the biological claim itself.

scientific_question: Was the evidence source queried completely for the intended gene and evidence-class universe?
potential_data_source_class: query manifests, API response logs, source coverage documentation, and failure records
evidence_quality_checks: denominator definition|query completeness|failure capture|NOT_FOUND versus NOT_QUERIED distinction
dependency_control: Keep coverage evidence separate from biological evidence returned by the same query.
adequacy_criterion: Eligible, queried, returned, failed, NOT_FOUND, and NOT_APPLICABLE denominators reconcile.
interpretation_boundary: Complete retrieval does not imply that the source itself has complete biological coverage.

scientific_question: Does an independent source support, conflict with, or fail to cover the existing bounded claim?
potential_data_source_class: independent databases, primary studies, or orthogonal measurement resources
dependency_control: Verify that candidate sources do not reuse the same upstream database, cohort, or publication.
adequacy_criterion: At least one independently sourced corroborating or conflicting record, or explicit lack of an eligible source.
interpretation_boundary: Corroboration reduces source-specific uncertainty but does not prove causality or actionability.

scientific_question: Have source records changed since the frozen evidence snapshot?
potential_data_source_class: official versioned source releases and timestamped query snapshots
evidence_quality_checks: release identification|query reproducibility|change detection|record withdrawal/update capture
dependency_control: A refresh must preserve source lineage and must not be treated as an independent source.
adequacy_criterion: A current, versioned retrieval snapshot can be compared record-by-record with the frozen snapshot.
interpretation_boundary: Recency reduces temporal uncertainty but does not increase biological validity by itself.
